data.one_liner: A Flutter package to show custom in-app notifications with any widgets.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display custom in-app notifications using any Flutter widget. It requires placing an InAppNotification widget in the app tree and calling a static method to trigger notifications.
use_when: You want to display custom widget-based alerts or notifications within the app.
You need swipe-to-dismiss gestures for in-app messages.
avoid_when: You need background push notifications delivered via operating system services.
strengths: Supports custom widgets for notification bodies.
Includes horizontal swipe gesture to dismiss notifications.
Automatic consideration of safe area padding.
weaknesses: Relies on placing an InAppNotification widget high in the app tree.
Limited documentation beyond basic usage and roadmaps.
data.setup_notes: Place the InAppNotification widget above your MaterialApp in the widget tree.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: For system-level local notifications instead of custom in-app overlay notifications.

alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative UI options for rich toast and banner notifications.
